title: The Insatiable

moves.title: Liquify Ground
effects: Add 3 Frantic Escape to draw pile and 3 to discard pile

move_pattern: Starts with Liquify Ground. Then cycles: Thrash → Lunging Bite → Salivate → Thrash → Thrash
notes: Liquify Ground applies Sandpit power (amount 4) and adds 6 Frantic Escape status cards to the player's deck (3 to draw pile, 3 to discard pile). This move also sets the HasLiquified flag, which changes the creature's Hit animation for the rest of combat. The bestiary includes a Devour move (not part of regular combat cycle) that uses the eat_player animation.
